name: so.ojo/mcp-server
title: oJo — HTML to image and PDF
description: Fill an HTML template with JSON and get a hosted PDF or image link. Free previews, no key.

environmentVariables.name: OJO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: oJo API key — create one at https://ojo.so/dashboard/api. Optional: without it the server runs in preview-only mode, where create_preview_link renders free full-resolution previews with no account.
